chapter.verse: Khris a etteh khat ka hih mah bangin note in zong kei hong etteh un.
Note in na khempeuh ah kei hong phawkin zatngeizia thute zong kong ap bang lianin lenkip na hih manun kong pakta hi.
Ahi zongin na theihtel ding uh ka deih thu ah pasal khempeuh' lutang pen Khris, numei' lutang pen pasal, Khris lutang pen Pasian ahi hi.
A lu a khuh kawmin thu a ngen, kam a sang, pasal peuhmah a lu a daisak hi a,
ahi zongin a lu khuh lo pi-in thu a ngen, kam a sang, numei peuhmah a lu a daisak ahi hi. Tua pen a sam a kimet tawh kibang ahih man hi.
Numei in a lu a khuh kei ding leh a sam a met ding ahi hi. Ahi zongin numei' adingin sammet leh samkiat a zumhuai thu ahih manin numei in a lu khuh ta hen.
Banghanghiam cihleh pasal pen Pasian' limlemel leh minphatna ahih manin a lu a khuh ding kilawm lo a, numei ahihleh pasal' minphatna ahi hi.
Pasal pen numei panin piang lo a, numei pen pasal panin piang hi.
Tua mah bangin pasal pen numei' ading kipiangsak hilo a, numei pen pasal' adinga kipiangsak ahi hi.
Tua thu hangin numei in vanmite' huhau-in a lu tungah ukzawhna lim a neih ding kilawm hi.
Himah taleh Topa sungah numei pen pasal tawh lo-in tangdin theilo a, pasal zong numei tawh lo-in tangdin theilo hi.
A hang pen pasal tungtawnin numei hong piang ahih zah khatin numei panin pasal a piang hi a, na khempeuh Pasian' kiangpan ahi hi.
Nomaumah in khentel un: numei in a lu khuh lo pi-in Pasian' kiangah thu a nget ding kilawm ahi hiam?
Pasal in samsau a hawi leh ama' ading zumhuai ahihlam pianngeizia thu mahmah in hong hilh hilo ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin numei in samsau a hawi leh ama' minphatna hilo ahi hiam? Numei' samsau pen kikhuhna dialpuan dinga kipia ahi hi.
Ahi zongin hong nial nuam khatpeuh a om leh ei i hi-a Pasian' pawlpite ahi zongin zatzia dang a nei i om kei hi.
Ahi zongin note na kikhop uh ciangin hoihzawk nading sangin siatzawk nading suah na hih manun a nuai-a kong vaikhak uh thute ah kong pakta kei hi.
Khatna ah, note pawlpi khat bangin na kikhop uh ciangin note' lakah kikhenkakna om cih ka za hi. A maanna ciang khat om dingin zong ka um hi.
A hang pen note' lakah kua teng citak muanhuai cih a kitheihkhiat nadingin note' sungah pawltuam neihna a om ding mah ahi hi.
Mun khat ah na kikhop uh ciangin na nekkhop uh pen Topa' nitak ankuang hilo hi.
A hang pen nekkhawm na zat uh ciangin mi kim in nomau' an tek lakhol na hih manun khat gilkialin a dang khat zukhamin na om uh hi.

Bangci lawmlawm! Na nek na dawn nading uh inn nei lo na hi uh hiam? Pasian' pawlpi thusim lo-in bangmah neilote neubawl na hi uh hiam? Bang hong gen lai ding ka hi hiam? Hih vai ah note hong phat ding ka hi hiam? Kong phat kei ding hi.
A hang pen Topa' kiangpan ka ngah, note' kiangah zong kong apsawn thu pen in: Topa Jesu in amah a kilehhek ni zanin anlum la a,
hehpih a phat khit ciangin balnenin, “Hih pen note' adinga hong kipia keima' pumpi ahi hi. Kei nong phawkna uh tawh hih bangin hih un,” ci hi.
Tua dan mahin nitak an a nek khit uh ciangin hai zong la a, “Hih hai pen keima' sisan sunga thuciamna thak ahi hi. Hih na dawn simun kei nong phawkna uh tawh hih bangin hih un,” ci hi.
A hang pen hih anlum ne-in hih hai na dawn simun Topa hong pai dong ama' sihna a pulak na hi uh hi.
Tua hangin omzia kilawm lo pi tawh Topa' anlum leh hai a ne a dawn peuhpeuh Topa' pumpi leh sisan tungah a khial hiding hi.
Tua hi a, mi kim amahmah kisittel henla, tua ciangin anlum ne-in hai dawn ta hen.
A hang pen pumpi khentel lo pi-in a ne a dawn peuhmah amahmah thukhenna a kitun dingin a ne a dawn ahi hi.
Note tampitak thazawmin cina-in a tamkhop na sih uh pen hih thu hang ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ei-le-ei maantak ki-entel lehang thukhenna i thuak kei ding hi.
Himah taleh Topa in eite thu hong khen ciangin leitung tawh mawhsak thukhenna i thuakkhopkhak loh nadingin eite hong sek hizaw hi.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, nekkhawm zang dingin na kikhop uh ciangin khatlekhat kingak un.
Na kikhop uh ciangin Pasian' gawtna hong tun loh nadingin a gilkial a om leh inn ah an ne hen. Thudangte ahihleh kong tun ciangin kong vaihawm ding hi.
